findings.reason: extending the existing fingerprint to the collateral query is the honest fix and turns "digest server-side" from an unmeasured proposal into a reuse of proven machinery, changing the design text and its "what has to be shown".
findings.text: the "digest server-side" option proposes computing the collateral hash in Cypher so property maps never cross the wire, but `_participant_snapshot` already computes a canonical in-Cypher `property_fingerprint` (property-key ordering, valueType, zoned-datetime and list normalisation) and it is already used as a live before/after guard at signed_manifest.py:4701-4709; the plan neither cites it nor says why the collateral case cannot reuse it

findings.reason: naming `_out_of_allowlist_source_hash` as the owner to generalise gives the plan the mechanism it needs for "owned dimensions derived from the operation rather than hand-declared per repair", replacing an open design question, rather than inventing a parallel one.
findings.text: the "narrow the snapshot" option duplicates the narrowed, dimension-scoped collateral proof that already exists as `_out_of_allowlist_source_hash` (StandardNameSource nodes outside the allowlist plus their bindings and backings) and its per-adapter dispatch in `_build_stale_source_preview` (signed_manifest.py:3464); a second narrowing path beside that owner drifts from it and re-decides which dimensions can be blinded

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the change lands inside the single existing function `_collateral_snapshot` (signed_manifest.py:2288); the plan proposes no new module family and no spread of internal wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the "narrow the snapshot" option re-proposes a shape the file already carries per adapter in `_out_of_allowlist_source_hash` (signed_manifest.py:1880), rather than extending it to the dimension the operation owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; both candidate fixes are internal to signed_manifest.py and the plan adds no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan's "digest server-side" option re-proposes a mechanism `_participant_snapshot` already implements in Cypher (signed_manifest.py:2227, live guard at :4701-4709), and it cites that machinery nowhere.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — neither option adds a layer over existing machinery; both edit the existing snapshot in place and the plan requires the existing guard tests to pass unchanged.
